question: Who transmitted the teaching to the earth-moving yoginīs who are good eaters?
premises: The recipients are the earth-moving yoginīs
They are described as good eaters
inference: The teaching was told to the earth-moving, good-eating yoginīs by an earth-mover.
uncertainties: The meaning of subhakṣāṇāṃ is contextually uncertain.
plain_english: O beloved, it was told to the earth-moving yoginīs, the good eaters, by an earth-mover.
